title: orca-coordinator config: repos and CLI adapters
description: Optional, advanced, config.yaml-only. The coordinator detects its ticketing and chat tools itself (MCP servers, CLIs) and writes each item's own url; these blocks only feed the zero-model shell prechecks and adapters/*.sh, which cannot call MCP. Top-level adapters are the default; a repos[] entry may carry its own ticketing / chat block; a repository's own .orca-coordinator.yaml (at its root) wins over both. Other keys are checked in bin/lib/config.mjs.

ticketing.description: A ticketing CLI adapter (adapters/ticketing/<kind>.sh) for the shell prechecks. Optional.

issueUrl.description: Optional link template with {id}, used only by the adapter's `url` verb. The panel links each item to its own url.

chat.description: A chat CLI adapter (adapters/chat/<kind>.sh) for the shell prechecks. Optional.

path.description: The top level of a git work tree.
